vsm1.3:74.5: Keci pana rāgādīnaṃ saṃsaggasannipātavasena aparāpi catasso,
vsm1.3:74.6: tathā saddhādīnanti imāhi aṭṭhahi saddhiṃ cuddasa icchanti.
vsm1.3:74.8: rāgādīnaṃ saddhādīhipi saṃsaggaṃ katvā anekā cariyā honti,
vsm1.3:75.1: Tattha yasmā rāgacaritassa kusalappavattisamaye saddhā balavatī hoti,
vsm1.3:75.3: Yathā hi akusalapakkhe rāgo siniddho nātilūkho, evaṃ kusalapakkhe saddhā.
vsm1.3:75.4: Yathā rāgo vatthukāme pariyesati, evaṃ saddhā sīlādiguṇe.
vsm1.3:75.5: Yathā rāgo ahitaṃ na pariccajati, evaṃ saddhā hitaṃ na pariccajati, tasmā rāgacaritassa saddhācarito sabhāgo.
vsm1.3:76.1: Yasmā pana dosacaritassa kusalappavattisamaye paññā balavatī hoti,
vsm1.3:76.3: Yathā hi akusalapakkhe doso nissineho na ārammaṇaṃ allīyati, evaṃ kusalapakkhe paññā.
vsm1.3:76.4: Yathā ca doso abhūtampi dosameva pariyesati, evaṃ paññā bhūtaṃ dosameva.
vsm1.3:76.5: Yathā doso sattaparivajjanākārena pavattati, evaṃ paññā saṅkhāraparivajjanākārena, tasmā dosacaritassa buddhicarito sabhāgo.
vsm1.3:77.1: Yasmā pana mohacaritassa anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya vāyamamānassa yebhuyyena antarāyakarā vitakkā uppajjanti,
vsm1.3:77.3: Yathā hi moho paribyākulatāya anavaṭṭhito, evaṃ vitakko nānappakāravitakkanatāya.
vsm1.3:77.4: Yathā ca moho apariyogāhaṇatāya cañcalo. Tathā vitakko lahuparikappanatāya, tasmā mohacaritassa vitakkacarito sabhāgoti.
vsm1.3:78.1: Apare taṇhāmānadiṭṭhivasena aparāpi tisso cariyā vadanti.
vsm1.3:78.2: Tattha taṇhā rāgoyeva, māno ca taṃsampayuttoti tadubhayaṃ rāgacariyaṃ nātivattati.
vsm1.3:78.3: Mohanidānattā ca diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhicariyā mohacariyameva anupatati.
vsm1.3:80.1: Tatra purimā tāva tisso cariyā pubbāciṇṇanidānā,
vsm1.3:80.7: Pubbe majjapānabahulo sutaparipucchāvihīno ca mohacarito hoti,
vsm1.3:81.1: Dvinnaṃ pana dhātūnaṃ ussannattā puggalo mohacarito hoti
vsm1.3:82.1: Tattha yasmā pubbe iṭṭhappayogasubhakammabahulāpi saggā cavitvā idhūpapannāpi ca
vsm1.3:82.4: Evaṃ dhātūnañca yathāvutteneva nayena ussadaniyamo nāma natthi.
vsm1.3:82.5: Dosaniyame ca rāgamohadvayameva vuttaṃ, tampi ca pubbāparaviruddhameva.
vsm1.3:82.6: Saddhācariyādīsu ca ekissāpi nidānaṃ na vuttameva.
vsm1.3:83.3: ‘‘ime sattā pubbahetuniyāmena lobhussadā dosussadā mohussadā alobhussadā adosussadā amohussadā ca honti.
vsm1.3:83.4: Yassa hi kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobho balavā hoti alobho mando,
vsm1.3:83.6: tassa mando alobho lobhaṃ pariyādātuṃ na sakkoti.
vsm1.3:83.7: Adosāmohā pana balavanto dosamohe pariyādātuṃ sakkoti.
vsm1.3:83.8: Tasmā so tena kammena dinnapaṭisandhivasena nibbatto
vsm1.3:84.1: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobhadosā balavanto honti alobhādosā mandā,
vsm1.3:84.3: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti duṭṭho ca.
vsm1.3:84.4: Paññavā pana hoti vajirūpamañāṇo dattābhayatthero viya.
vsm1.3:84.5: Yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe lobhādosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,
vsm1.3:84.6: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti dandho ca,
vsm1.3:84.8: Tathā yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe tayopi lobhadosamohā balavanto honti alobhādayo mandā,
vsm1.3:84.9: so purimanayeneva luddho ceva hoti duṭṭho ca mūḷho ca.
vsm1.3:85.1: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhadosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,
vsm1.3:85.2: so purimanayeneva aluddho appakileso hoti dibbārammaṇampi disvā niccalo,
vsm1.3:85.4: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhādosamohā balavanto honti itare mandā,
vsm1.3:85.5: so purimanayeneva aluddho ceva hoti aduṭṭho sīlako ca,
vsm1.3:85.7: Tathā yassa kammāyūhanakkhaṇe alobhadosāmohā balavanto honti itare mandā,
vsm1.3:85.8: so purimanayeneva aluddho ceva hoti paññavā ca,
vsm1.3:85.10: Yassa pana kammāyūhanakkhaṇe tayopi alobhādosāmohā balavanto honti lobhādayo mandā,
vsm1.3:85.11: so purimanayeneva mahāsaṅgharakkhitatthero viya aluddho aduṭṭho paññavā ca hotī’’ti.
vsm1.3:86.1: Ettha ca yo luddhoti vutto, ayaṃ rāgacarito.
vsm1.3:86.5: Yathā vā amohaparivārena kammunā nibbatto buddhicarito,
vsm1.3:87.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ kathañca jānitabbaṃ ayaṃ puggalo rāgacaritotiādi.
vsm1.3:87.3:
Iriyāpathato kiccā, bhojanā dassanādito;
Dhammappavattito ceva, cariyāyo vibhāvayeti.
vsm1.3:88.2: rāgacarito hi pakatigamanena gacchanto cāturiyena gacchati,
vsm1.3:88.10: chambhito viya padaṃ nikkhipati, chambhito viya uddharati,
vsm1.3:89.5: Rāgacarito ca ataramāno samaṃ seyyaṃ paññapetvā
vsm1.3:89.6: saṇikaṃ nipajjitvā aṅgapaccaṅgāni samodhāya pāsādikena ākārena sayati,
vsm1.3:89.9: Dosacarito taramāno yathā vā tathā vā seyyaṃ paññapetvā
vsm1.3:89.11: vuṭṭhāpiyamāno ca sīghaṃ vuṭṭhāya kupito viya paṭivacanaṃ deti.
vsm1.3:89.14: vuṭṭhāpiyamāno ca huṅkāraṃ karonto dandhaṃ vuṭṭhāti.
vsm1.3:91.3: ataramāno vālikaṃ avippakiranto sinduvārakusumasantharamiva santharanto suddhaṃ samaṃ sammajjati.
vsm1.3:91.5: taramānarūpo ubhato vālikaṃ ussārento kharena saddena asuddhaṃ visamaṃ sammajjati.
vsm1.3:92.5: Cīvaradhāraṇampi ca rāgacaritassa nātigāḷhaṃ nātisithilaṃ hoti pāsādikaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ.
vsm1.3:93.2: bhuñjamāno ca nātimahantaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ ālopaṃ katvā rasapaṭisaṃvedī ataramāno bhuñjati,
vsm1.3:93.3: kiñcideva ca sāduṃ labhitvā somanassaṃ āpajjati.
vsm1.3:93.5: bhuñjamāno ca mukhapūrakaṃ ālopaṃ katvā arasapaṭisaṃvedī taramāno bhuñjati,
vsm1.3:93.6: kiñcideva ca asāduṃ labhitvā domanassaṃ āpajjati.
vsm1.3:93.8: bhuñjamāno ca aparimaṇḍalaṃ parittaṃ ālopaṃ katvā
vsm1.3:93.9: bhājane chaḍḍento mukhaṃ makkhento vikkhittacitto taṃ taṃ vitakkento bhuñjati.
vsm1.3:94.1: Dassanāditoti rāgacarito īsakampi manoramaṃ rūpaṃ disvā vimhayajāto viya ciraṃ oloketi,
vsm1.3:94.5: Dosacarito īsakampi amanoramaṃ rūpaṃ disvā kilantarūpo viya na ciraṃ oloketi,
vsm1.3:94.9: Mohacarito yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ disvā parapaccayiko hoti,
